描述_EN: leappad products have been on the market since 1999, teaching young children how to read and write using state-of-the-art computer technology. studies show that learning through play is effective, and the leappad uses this to its advantage, with a variety of stimulating, interactive games that encourage children to use their reading and writing abilities. made by leapfrog, this leappad explorer was developed in 2011 and comes with features such as a camera and video recorder.
描述_ZN: leappad产品自1999年以来一直在市场上销售，使用最先进的计算机技术教幼儿如何阅读和写作。 研究表明，在游戏中学习是有效的，leappad利用了这一优势，通过各种刺激性的互动游戏，鼓励儿童使用他们的阅读和写作能力。 由leapfrog制造，这个leappad explorer是在2011年开发的，带有摄像头和录像机等功能。
